verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents its own alert integrations: Slack notifications to any channel, PagerDuty incidents created from error activity, and general alerting to communication tools. This covers the destination half of the story. The evidence does not show routing rules scoped by project, environment, or severity, or per-rule triggers for new issues, frequency spikes, or affected-user counts. missing for 10: per-rule thresholds (new issue, frequency spike, affected-user count), routing filters by environment/release stage and severity, documented email alert destination, independent or hands-on corroboration.
